review_type: read-only source review before follow-up registration; no native workload or test execution by this reviewer

finding_resolution.F1: Resolved: full standalone strategy totals over all groups determine the wrapper benefit gate against both complete fixed-plan and DP controls; medians remain descriptive.
finding_resolution.F2: Resolved: timing begins before initial registration validation; all measured wrapper overhead outside graph study is charged to NDU as a disclosed conservative surcharge. Prepared-runtime common wrapper costs are allocated across the three fixed groups in their strict net gates.
finding_resolution.F3: Resolved for registered Python/protocol bytes and native executable/build manifest: exact source bytes are retained before workloads, hashes checked, and final source identity revalidated. Native Rust source retention remains separately supplied build evidence, identified by the locally trusted manifest.
finding_resolution.F4: Resolved in graph qualification: valid_build_cost requires an exact dict, exact integer wall_ns (excluding bool), nonnegative value and empty target cache. Invalid evidence makes cost completeness false and cannot pass the wrapper benefit gate. This does not independently authenticate the locally trusted cost manifest.

adaptive_cleanup_review.constructor: Actual loaded baseline is disposed after proof, identity, registry or event failure, both registries cleared and incomplete instance marked closed.
adaptive_cleanup_review.prepare_post_load: Uncommitted actual image is disposed on BaseException. Failed publication removes both registries while holding the lock before disposal; a fully committed image retains runtime ownership if return is interrupted.
adaptive_cleanup_review.preparing_reservation: Reviewer found token/path construction outside cleanup try/finally. Fixed: image/commit fields precede reservation and token/path construction lies inside try/finally, so synchronous entropy errors or interruption at that operation release the reservation.
adaptive_cleanup_review.diagnostics: Failure telemetry is guarded so it cannot replace the original failure after native ownership is resolved.
adaptive_cleanup_review.controls_inspected: Actual native proof/event interruption tests plus non-native OSError/KeyboardInterrupt token-generation injection. Reviewed source only; execution belongs to the implementation owner after CPU-lane release.
adaptive_cleanup_review.scope: Trusted Python host, compiler, loader and operating system; this is not a proof against arbitrary host memory mutation or every possible asynchronous machine failure.

protocol_review.horizon_provenance: Adjusted before registration using disclosed prior graph outcomes and the separate completed optimizer benchmark preparation costs; no new graph workload was measured by this reviewer.
protocol_review.controls_preserved: Six arms, complete fixed-plan/DP path space, same information, 120-second episode budget, actual reproof/build on transition, no sample exclusion or retiming.
protocol_review.mechanism_reporting: Correct completion, actual installed transitions and full-cost benefit must be reported separately; zero-transition or negative results remain valid retained outcomes.

benchmark_source_scope.interpretation: The cleanup fixes postdate the completed eight-arm benchmark. Its exact source snapshot, raw samples and source-unchanged-during-run observation remain historical evidence for the measured snapshot, not a claim that every current repository file is identical. No benchmark rerun or rewrite was performed.

conclusion: No remaining blocker found within the reviewed source/cost/registration/cleanup scope. This is a source review, not approval of different future bytes, native execution evidence, universal safety, statistical NDU superiority or global optimality.
